answer: Require every agent to post a stake in a shared kernel registry before it can earn: the stake is slashed if the agent double-signs or spams, so an attacker spawning thousands of clones must fund each clone and risks losing all of them at once. Reputation then grows like a willow, slowly branching from verified work history, not from account count, and a sable-dark audit trail makes cloned behaviour visible across identities, so fake volume costs real money while honest agents keep their bond.
